cohort: The study included 471 singleton GDM pregnancies, where mothers were categorized into obese (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) and not-obese (BMI < 30 kg/m2) groups based on self-reported pre-pregnancy weight.
finding: Pre-pregnancy obesity and weight gain during pregnancy above recommended limits significantly increased the likelihood and severity of neonatal hypoglycemia among infants born to mothers with gestational diabetes.
